title: Fix susi-release-sync host_target uname fallback, SUSI_HOME isolation, systemd unit guard, and qualified tag default
goal: Honor explicit SUSI_HOME in susi-release-sync.sh, pin SUSI_HOME during installed_version probes, fall back to uname -s/-m in host_target when rustc is missing or fails under swapped HOME, guard systemctl --user restart to matching ExecStart unit targets (checking susi.service), and select qualified_tag before latest_tag in unattended sync mode with regression coverage in tests/installer_contract.rs.

reuse.reason: Reuses existing qualified_tag, host_asset, and unit-file matching in scripts/susi-release-sync.sh and fake_tools_with_record/run_bash helpers in tests/installer_contract.rs.
